queries.original_text: EVALUATE SELECTCOLUMNS(FILTER('Subscriptions', 'Subscriptions'[status] = "ACTIVE"), "subscription_id", 'Subscriptions'[subscription_id], "account_id", 'Subscriptions'[account_id], "plan_id", 'Subscriptions'[plan_id], "status", 'Subscriptions'[status], "plan_name", RELATED('Plans'[plan_name]), "monthly_price", RELATED('Plans'[monthly_price])) ORDER BY [subscription_id]
EVALUATE SUMMARIZECOLUMNS('Subscriptions'[status], "subscription_rows", COUNTROWS('Subscriptions'), "MRR All Plans", [MRR All Plans]) ORDER BY [status]
queries.new_query: EVALUATE TOPN(251,SUMMARIZECOLUMNS('Subscriptions'[status],"subscription_rows",COUNTROWS('Subscriptions'),"MRR All Plans",[MRR All Plans])) ORDER BY [status] ASC
